original_economy: Keep R10 original-payoff certificates, all models, historical manuscripts, original stopped contract and completed R9 frozen holdout unchanged.

external.initial_architecture: inherited two-layer width-48 actor and critic; equal initial hashes within each pair
external.method_specific: NBO: learning rate, evaluation-to-improvement ratio, transition particles. SOC: learning rate, adversary rate and width, J/K, initial multiplier, multiplier step. Explicit 12-candidate tables in robustness.py.
external.boundary_rule: After first 12 candidates, select minimum two-seed mean, ties smallest index. If selected multiplier is the current high/low boundary extend that direction by factor 3. Otherwise vary NBO particles (16 then 32) or SOC adversary rate (.003 then .03). Re-select between the two extension slots. Failures get infinite selection score and raw data are retained.
external.primary_estimand: paired NBO-minus-SOC sample-and-hold mean cost across independent training/audit seeds
external.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test; Bonferroni over three new dimension panels; alpha .05
external.negative_controls: Retain third clipped LQ policy; no R9 holdout seed reused; new holdout not tuned upon.
external.claims: Finite randomized tuning budget, not exhaustive best tuning. This post-R9 replication is not a retroactive preregistration of R9. Nominal training opportunity is matched; completed-update overshoot, setup and validation clocks are separately recorded.
external.failure: Failed tuning trials are retained with infinite selection score. Missing/nonfinite holdout invalidates its planned panel and primary aggregate. Collector runs always and commits successful siblings, failures and planned-cell statuses before rejecting an aggregate.

exact_accuracy_suite.reference: Independent continuous Riccati closed form enclosed by mpmath.iv; original cost of exact stored sample-and-hold gains enclosed by interval moment recursion. No Monte Carlo reference.
exact_accuracy_suite.policy_generators: Exact quadratic evaluation/improvement in a time-gated linear actor and Adam on the same feasible gain outputs (N=32, checkpoints 0,25,100,400). This structured architecture is not the original tanh actor or the pinned SOC comparator.
exact_accuracy_suite.timing: Generation, validation, and cumulative attained-accuracy clocks; setup excluded; each deterministic run records environment.
exact_accuracy_suite.scope: Heterogeneous reference-solvable control mechanisms complement, not replace, original stopped economy and original coupled nonconvex comparison. No universal external head-to-head accuracy dominance claimed.
